change: The same synthetic actor capability may arrive in the ev003_fixture_session cookie. Explicit Authorization remains authoritative; invalid bearer is not upgraded by a cookie. Duplicate/incorrect session cookies are denied. Existing grants, endpoints, durable effects and bearer behavior remain.

cookieProvisioning.name: ev003_fixture_session
cookieProvisioning.hostScope: Each exact original fixture host, no wildcard or leading-dot domain.
cookieProvisioning.sameSite: Set explicitly for the existing fixture browser context.

evidence.scope: Real loopback HTTP on public toy fixtures only: cookie/bearer success, wrong/duplicate cookie, wrong host, explicit invalid-bearer precedence and no header/token in journal.

limitations: No original service data, browser/native participant or model execution.
Cookies are not port-scoped; concrete browser egress must remain limited to exact original fixture endpoints and required control endpoints.
HttpOnly prevents document script access, not privileged Playwright context inspection. No claim that the existing entire native tool catalog cannot inspect cookies.
Fixture schema, ready output and journal never return capability values or request headers; actual participant traces remain private.
Synthetic fixture capability only; no provider credentials changed or read.
